fusions.name: Schooled Kick
fusions.desc: A drilled hoof strike that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. For 2 seconds after, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Perfect Approach
fusions.desc: A rehearsed charging kick at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Second Nature
fusions.desc: Readies one of your abilities that is cooling down, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Into Stride
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, your critical hit chance rises by 12% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
